verses.text: Samson went down to Timnah and spotted a Philistine woman there. 👀
He came home and told his parents, ‘I saw a Philistine woman in Timnah. Go get her for me—I want to marry her.’ 💍

His parents asked, ‘Can’t you find a wife among our relatives or anywhere in our people? Why marry one of those uncircumcised Philistines?’ Samson told his father, ‘Get her for me. She’s the one I want.’ 🗣️
His parents didn’t know this was from Yahweh, who was setting up an opportunity against the Philistines. At that time, the Philistines ruled Israel. ⚖️
Samson went down to Timnah with his parents. When they reached the vineyards, a young lion suddenly roared at him. 🦁
Yahweh’s Spirit came powerfully over him, and he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as easily as tearing a young goat. But he didn’t tell his parents what he’d done. 💪
He went down and talked with the woman, and she was the one he wanted. 💬
Later he came back to marry her and turned aside to check the lion’s body. There was a swarm of bees and honey inside the carcass. 🍯
He scooped up the honey and ate as he walked. He also gave some to his parents, and they ate it too—but he didn’t tell them he’d taken it from the lion’s body. 🍯
His father went down to the woman’s home, and Samson put on a feast, as young men did in those days. 🎉
When the Philistines saw him, they assigned thirty companions to stay with him. 👥
Samson told them, ‘I’ve got a riddle for you. If you solve it during the seven days of the feast, I’ll give you thirty linen outfits and thirty changes of clothes. 🧩
‘But if you can’t solve it, you give me thirty linen outfits and thirty changes of clothes.’ They said, ‘Tell us the riddle; let’s hear it.’ 👕
He said, ‘Food came out of the eater; sweetness came out of the strong.’ For three days, they couldn’t solve it. 🧠
On the seventh day, they told Samson’s wife, ‘Get your husband to explain the riddle, or we’ll burn you and your father’s family alive. Did you invite us here to make us broke?’ 🔥

Samson’s wife cried in front of him: ‘You hate me; you don’t love me. You gave my people a riddle and didn’t even tell me the answer.’ He said, ‘I didn’t tell my parents either, so why would I tell you?’ 😢
She cried to him through all seven days of the feast. On the seventh day he finally told her, because she kept pressing him. Then she told her people the answer. 💔

Before sunset on the seventh day, the city’s men said, ‘What’s sweeter than honey? What’s stronger than a lion?’ Samson answered, ‘If you hadn’t plowed with my heifer, you wouldn’t have solved my riddle.’ 🐝

Yahweh’s Spirit came powerfully over Samson. He went down to Ashkelon, killed thirty men, took their clothes, and gave the outfits to the men who solved his riddle. Burning with anger, he went back to his father’s house. ⚔️
Samson’s wife was then given to the companion who had been his best man. 💔
